# 1 Scope

This standard specifies requirements for governing, executing, recording, and assessing AI workflows in which human, AI-agent, service, or deterministic-workflow participants perform coordinated work toward a declared outcome.

It applies to fixed and dynamically planned workflows, including long-running work and workflows with external effects. It specifies a semantic contract that may be implemented using existing orchestration engines and protocols.

It does not prescribe a model, prompt format, user interface, transport, orchestration product, memory database, or private reasoning representation. It does not establish domain-specific safety limits, determine legal obligations, or certify the substantive correctness of an AI model. Organizations supply applicable domain rules through controlled policies and criteria.
